name: GM - Bay City Powertrain, Bay City MI

fieldNotes.location: Roster point and a ROOFTOP geocode of 1001 Woodside Ave landed at 43.60418,-83.87910, the south frontage of the active GM Bay City Powertrain plant. Locked site center to 43.6052,-83.8800, the centroid of the large single manufacturing complex (older north-light/sawtooth bays on the west, newer flat-roof big-box section on the east) fronting Woodside Ave on the Saginaw River. Confirmed active via GM Authority and DBusiness: ~975,000 sq ft, ~420 UAW Local 362 workers, building camshafts/connecting rods/block-and-head machining for V8 propulsion, with a recent $216M+ investment. The cleared/debris land immediately WEST and NW of the building (settling ponds, foundation remnants, dirt service roads) is the separate ~10-acre RACER Trust 'Bay City Powertrain Industrial Land' parcel (former GM equipment-storage area + filled river slip), not part of the active fenced plant.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Active fenced GM parcel traced from the Saginaw-River/RACER-land edge on the west, rail corridor and ponds on the north, residential street on the east, and Woodside Ave on the south. ~58 acres. Street View (2023-07) shows a continuous chain-link perimeter fence along the entire Woodside Ave frontage.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Site is fully perimeter-fenced (continuous chain-link confirmed in Street View along Woodside Ave). Access from Woodside is a controlled curb-cut gate opening into the paved south lot; treated as a truck gate. No barrier-arm detail resolvable from overhead or Street View at this zoom.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No distinct staffed guard booth resolved at the Woodside frontage in z20 satellite or 2023 Street View. Low confidence on absence at an older urban plant where a booth may sit just inside the fence line.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true: there is a controlled fenced truck entrance but no visible staffed booth, implying kiosk / call-box / badge check-in. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Gate-to-building approach across the south lot is short with little dedicated truck-queue depth; trucks would proceed into the yard rather than stack 3+ deep at the gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Truck/material handling is concentrated on the NORTH building face along the rail spine, not the parking-side south face. Estimated ~18 dock/material doors across the rail-served north face and west service road; band 10-25. Old-plant roof clutter and the rail canopy obscure an exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very few trailers visible anywhere in captured imagery (roughly 4, along the west service road / RACER-land edge). No dedicated marked trailer-storage lot full of dropped trailers; band 0-10 and dropYard false. This is a components plant fed largely by rail plus modest truck dock activity, not a high-throughput cross-dock.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage yard observed; the large south paved area is employee/visitor car parking (rows of cars, landscaped diagonal islands), not a trailer drop yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: Confirmed: rail tracks run E-W along the north edge of the building with a covered rail dock/material spine hugging the north face; spurs curve in from the NW. Classic 1900s-era rail-served components plant.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Material in/out appears consolidated on the north rail-served face; no clearly separate second dock cluster on a different face was resolved. Left false.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1 in / 1 out at the Woodside gate from curb-cut width; not precisely countable.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant is embedded in the Bay City urban grid: residential blocks abut the east and south, downtown is a few blocks NE. Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~58 acres for the active fenced GM parcel only; the full historic site footprint was larger before ~10 acres transferred to RACER Trust.

citations.claim: GM lists Bay City Powertrain as an active GM facility building connecting rods, solid and sliding camshafts for Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, Cadillac
GM investing $216M at Bay City Powertrain for camshafts, connecting rods, block/head machining for future V8 production

verification.rationale: New GM-operated powertrain plant (~420 UAW Local 362), recent $216M investment; not a 2009-divested/RACER site (the adjacent ~10-acre RACER land is excluded from the active fenced parcel).
